blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mylene Paat-Rezanova didn’t need a starting role to make a winning impact for Farm Fresh. Coming off the bench, the veteran opposite hitter delivered 15 points as the Foxies completed a reverse sweep of the Choco Mucho Flying Titans, 20-25, 26-28, 25-23, 25-23, 15-13, in the 2026-27 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Thursday at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City. Her timely contribution and leadership in the comeback, which gave Farm Fresh its second win in three games, earned Paat-Rezanova the PVL Press Corps Player of the Week citation.
